name: transformation-hub
description: Mobily Transformation & Transactions Hub (working name) — program, project and committee management platform

scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @hub/api run build && pnpm --filter @hub/web run build
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @hub/domain --filter @hub/contracts run test && pnpm --filter @hub/api run test
scripts.db:seed:demo: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @hub/api run build && pnpm --filter @hub/api run seed:demo
scripts.db:bootstrap: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @hub/api run build && pnpm --filter @hub/api run bootstrap
scripts.db:reset:dev: bash scripts/dev/db-reset.sh hub_dev && bash scripts/dev/db-reset.sh hub_test
scripts.openapi: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @hub/api run build && pnpm --filter @hub/api run openapi
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @hub/domain run build && pnpm --filter @hub/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @hub/db run build
